derivation: TopCat.ext fun p ↦ ContinuousMap.Homotopy.symm_apply F (I.homeomorph p.2, p.1)
explanation: The independent lemma generated by @[simps] on Homotopy.symm states F.symm x = F (σ x.1, x.2). Applying it at the displayed pair and using extensionality gives the target after definitional unfolding.
